# Mubeen Arabic Institute (مبين)

> Online classical Arabic for homeschooled students aged 7 and up, taught by madrasa-trained teachers in small pods (3–6 students) or private classes. Website: https://mubeenarabic.org

Mubeen Arabic Institute (also "Mubeen Arabic", Arabic: مبين) teaches classical Arabic, the foundation of the Islamic sciences, to children and teenagers in homeschooling Muslim families, mainly English-speaking families in North America, the UK and Europe. All classes are online.

Mubeen Arabic Institute is a separate organisation from other projects that share the word "Mubeen" (for example the Mubeen online platform of Al Qasimia University, Mubeen Qur'an Institute at mubeen.org, or academies in Cairo).

## How it teaches
- The traditional madrasa method: a teacher reads classical texts with the students line by line, as their authors intended.
- Each week: two core lessons (dars) and one review session (muthākarah).
- Sessions last 45–60 minutes, on Zoom or Google Meet; every lesson is recorded.
- Schedules are agreed with each family to fit their time zone.

## Curriculum (8 classical texts)
1. Durūs al-Lughah al-ʿArabiyyah 1 (دروس اللغة العربية ١)
2. Durūs al-Lughah al-ʿArabiyyah 2 (دروس اللغة العربية ٢)
3. Qaṣaṣ al-Nabiyyīn (قصص النبيين)
4. al-Amthilah (الأمثلة)
5. al-Bināʾ (البناء)
6. al-Maqṣūd (المقصود)
7. al-ʿAwāmil (العوامل)
8. al-Ājurrūmiyyah (الآجرومية)
The path is a guide; books may be adjusted to the student's level in consultation with parents.

## Free trial and tuition (USD)
- Every new student gets two free sessions (one dars, one muthākarah) inside a running class; the teacher places the child during them.
- Learning pods: $120 per student per month.
- Private classes: $200 for 1 student, $300 for 2 siblings, $400 for 3, custom plan for 4+.
- Monthly payment for 12 sessions; payment starts only after the free sessions; cancel before any new month.
